trust_region.method: Backtrack the proposed Adam parameter displacement against exact analytic reference KL on the same native-image batch, halving at most12times. Every image mean-query KL must not exceed max(.1, its pre-step value). Restore parameter/buffer/optimizer state and fail before committing if no step qualifies.

trust_region.optimizer_moments: Keep gradient moments for an accepted scaled displacement; count one accepted update. Failed proposals are restored and abort. All forward/backtrack time counts toward matched activewall SFT budget.

first_learning_test.budget_enforcement: Direct API, CLI and durable workflow bind this same scientific configuration. Device/CPU thread count are resource choices; pixel_std is selected only by the passing TRAIN pilot. Input max_steps must be explicit and at most64.
